page_title: NEW 3-0 AST | Newcastle v Aston Villa 26/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) replacing Bruno Guimaraes.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. William Osula (Newcastle Utd) comes on in place of Alexander Isak.
90+1' 3 - 0 GOAL! Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 3:0.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Newcastle was in an offside position.
85' Aston Villa keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
83' Celebrations are cut short for Newcastle as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
82' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
81' It’s a GOAL! What a comedy of errors as a defender blasts the ball into the body of Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), with the ball ricocheting off him into the back of the net!
80' The substitution is prepared. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing John McGinn.
79' The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Anthony Gordon and he is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
78' Looks like Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
78' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Jacob Murphy is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
78' Substitution. Kieran Trippier makes way for Matt Targett (Newcastle Utd).
76' The attendance is 52168.
73' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
73' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.
72' The resulting corner, taken by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.

72' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick, but Martin Dubravka reads it well and stops the effort.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) coming on for Morgan Rogers.
69' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Kosta Nedeljkovic (Aston Villa) replaces Matty Cash.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Boubacar Kamara will be replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
68' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Emiliano Martinez reads it well and gathers the ball.
67' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
65' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) spurns a big chance! He gets to the rebound but only hits the crossbar!

65' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
64' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
64' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
64' Newcastle earn a corner.
64' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
62' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
62' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
59' 2 - 0 Goal! Jacob Murphy puts the ball on a plate for Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:0.
58' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) tackles a bit over-zealously and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
56' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
56' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.

54' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Emiliano Martinez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
53' Newcastle are seeing far more of the ball now.

52' Ambitious effort from Joelinton (Newcastle Utd). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
51' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

51' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
48' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

48' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
46' Half-time substitution. Unai Emery decided to make a change. Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is replaced by Ollie Watkins.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is flagged offside.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45' The resulting corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.

44' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Emiliano Martinez anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Newcastle win a corner kick.
41' Fine play by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
36' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 65:35.
34' A VAR review has confirmed the red card for Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).

33' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa), but referee Anthony Taylor must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
32' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!

30' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) slammed the ball from a mid-range free kick towards the net! He unleashed a low shot that went to the left, exactly where the keeper was standing. Such an easy save for him.
29' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
27' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) works the corner short.

25' A decent save by Emiliano Martinez. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
23' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Anthony Taylor didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
22' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) has an opportunity, but isn't able to direct the ball into the net.
22' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Martin Dubravka to dive and make a save.

21' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Anthony Taylor with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
19' The linesman raises his flag for offside before John McGinn (Aston Villa) heads on.
18' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes it short.
14' The foul by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
12' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
11' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

10' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Anthony Taylor blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
9' Aston Villa take a short corner kick.
8' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Aston Villa force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' John McGinn (Aston Villa) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
7' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).

5' A snap shot from distance by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Joelinton tees up Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will officiate today.
